works.body:
Hello! I really admire your artwork and wanted to ask if you would consider a scenario featuring my couple, Yahari and Mahiro.

The idea is a lighthearted scene on a sunny day. Yahari (on the left) is playfully bothering Mahiro, leaning into his more flirtatious and dominant personality. Mahiro (on the right), despite being taller, is more sensitive and visibly annoyed by Yahari’s teasing. Their contrasting dynamics are an important part of their relationship, and I’d love to see that reflected in their expressions and body language.

The exact pose is completely up to you, I trust your artistic vision.
Here is a reference for the characters:
https://x.com/Cossmichild/status/2007197586881687713

こんにちは！僕のOCの絵をリクエストしてもいいですか？ヒゲがたくさんで筋肉もあるので、楽しく描いてもらえると嬉しいです(笑)。

彼は大きくて威圧的な男だけど、心の底では優しいんだ。バイクに乗ることと、タバコを吸うことと、海のそばでリラックスすることが好きなんだ。

自由に好きなように描いてください。

よろしくお願いします！
